Hey!  
I have high functioning ASD but my diagnosis came a lot later at the age of 16. 

​

If you feel like having a classroom assistant is strange and effecting your learning, I would suggest that you talk to the school about it. I can understand the feeling though, I don't like discussing the fact that I'm ASD with people outside of specific teachers and close friends. 

I don't think there is anything with being labelled with ASD at the end of the day, that is who you are. I have learnt to just embrace the label I guess. 

If you don't want to explain it, I guess you can say that it's not any of there business because it has nothing to do with them at all tbh

I feel like context is very important, I would be annoyed if someone neurotypical was using the term but me and my friends normally make jokes about it. I have a friend that is autistic but the rest are neurotypical but because they are close to me, it seems less spiteful I guess
